name: A00_1_plus_one_hits_each_opponent_and_not_its_controller
notes: Printed: '[+1]: Chandra deals 3 damage to each opponent.' Three players, so 'each opponent' is told from 'target opponent' and from 'each player': through the menu the +1 deals 3 damage to each of the two opponents (20 -> 17), none to its controller (20), and the loyalty cost is paid (5 -> 6).
